role: Fresh independent SCAFFOLD F27 implementation/integration reviewer; no nested agents or source edits.
summary: The corrected research equations and successful direct/spawn/configured round paths check out, but server model-half validation and durable client controls after failed worker handoff do not satisfy the accepted contracts. One high and one medium issue are independently reproduced on Python 3.13.16 and 3.14.8. Passing delivered tests do not close these issues.

findings.title: SCAFFOLD validates control halves but commits malformed model halves.
findings.cause: weights_received validates only payload[1], appends payload[0] without checking required model keys, per-client shapes or finiteness, then stages controls. The inherited aggregator can broadcast malformed shapes or omit a client key, and load_weights accepts NaN. The final aggregated shape cannot validate each original client model.

steps: Use the actual shipped TOML with explicit CPU/scalar/quadratic/SGD overrides, N=3.
Obtain a full valid report through actual example configure, inbound processing, training and outbound processing; num_samples=2.
Initial server x=1,c=2. Supply two reports: first model theta=[7], delta theta=[3]; second delta theta=[4] with model theta=[NaN], missing theta={}, or scalar theta=9 instead of shape [1].
Call actual server._process_reports(), including its inherited aggregate_weights, load_weights and weights_aggregated hooks.
concrete_reproducer.expected: Reject the entire batch before arithmetic/commit; model x=1 and control c=2 remain unchanged.
concrete_reproducer.actual: All three cases finish report processing without an exception. Global x becomes NaN, 3.5, or 8 respectively; c commits 13/3 in every case.

findings.impact: A malformed model paired with valid controls can corrupt the global model and advance population controls. The selected whole-batch atomic model/control contract is not satisfied.
findings.provenance: This does not assert a newly introduced generic B aggregation regression. It is an unclosed F27 implementation obligation in the SCAFFOLD subclass; generic B FedAvg and its adapter payload policies are unchanged.
findings.bounded_correction: Validate each SCAFFOLD model half against the applicable model payload schema before staging either half, preserving existing model-buffer aggregation and accepted B adapter semantics. Add the failing raw-model cases and atomicity assertions to the SCAFFOLD integration tests.

findings.title: A failed worker handoff advances canonical client controls that routine reuse later adopts.
findings.cause: The child overwrites the canonical ci checkpoint in on_train_end before model saving/current-token state handoff is complete. A failed handoff correctly refuses outbound processing and retains old parent ci, but unsuccessful cleanup only clears transient delta. The advanced canonical ci is then loaded by normal identity reassignment or reconstruction.

steps: Real shipped max_concurrency spawn path, CPU quadratic target 0, sample_count=2, epochs=2, eta=.1. Initial x=1,c=2,ci=1; a real pre-existing canonical checkpoint stores ci=1 and fresh construction verifies it.

A scratch-only trainer subclass calls the unchanged actual worker then removes its required current training-state handoff file. This is the same missing-state failure class exercised by the delivered worker negative test.
Actual outbound refuses the failed handoff; parent ci remains 1 and no delta is emitted.
Run ordinary configure-based logical identity reuse 1->2->1 and reconstruct client 1. Both read ci=.9 from the failed attempt.
Restore the ordinary trainer and retry the same x=1,c=2. Inspect the real successful spawned model, ci and outbound delta.
concrete_reproducer.expected: Preserve the last successful canonical ci=1 across the rejected handoff and ordinary client reuse; successful retry yields y=.62,ci=.9,delta=-.1.
concrete_reproducer.actual: Rejected attempt leaves parent ci=1 but persisted/reloaded ci=.9. Successful retry yields y=.601,ci=.895,delta=-.005, permanently omitting the failed attempt delta=-.1.
concrete_reproducer.numerical_consequence: For inactive ci=(3,2), applying only the successfully emitted retry delta to c=2 gives c=1.9983333333333335 while mean retained ci is 1.965. This consequence is independently calculated, not a convergence claim.

313.failed_handoff_error: SCAFFOLD has no successful current-round control delta.
313.expected: Failed handoff has no outbound delta; normal reuse must retain the pre-attempt ci=1. Retry should yield y=.62,ci=.9,delta=-.1.
313.interpretation: Exit zero asserts the defect, not acceptance success.

314.failed_handoff_error: SCAFFOLD has no successful current-round control delta.
314.expected: Failed handoff has no outbound delta; normal reuse must retain the pre-attempt ci=1. Retry should yield y=.62,ci=.9,delta=-.1.
314.interpretation: Exit zero asserts the defect, not acceptance success.

findings.impact: A detected worker failure is followed by a successful numerically stale control update after normal logical-client reuse. The parent and durable state disagree, and server/client population controls lose their invariant.
findings.scope_boundary: This uses normal 1->2->1 configure reuse and fresh client reconstruction in the existing process/config, with a seeded canonical last-successful checkpoint. It does not require a full server/optimizer/RNG restart protocol.
findings.bounded_correction: Stage worker controls until the parent accepts the current successful model/control handoff, or reliably restore the prior canonical controls on rejected attempts. Extend the current failed-worker test through normal client reuse and a successful retry.

low_findings_note: No additional concrete low-severity issue recorded; stylistic recommendations are not presented as bugs.

primary_source.independent_read: Opened and inspected Algorithm 1 and Eq 3-5 in the versioned primary PDF through web; independently downloaded exact bytes into owned scratch.
primary_source.independent_derivation: Summing constant-rate vanilla SGD local updates yields (x-y)/(K*eta)=mean(g)-ci+c; substituting gives ci_new=mean(g). Appendix Eq19 has the apparent reversed c/ci sign and fails the independent g=0,c=2,ci=1 displacement counterexample; main equations take priority.
primary_source.limits: No paper convergence or mean-gradient claim for sample-weighted unequal-count global models or nonvanilla optimizers.

contract.criteria: Run float64 CPU real SGD and actual strategy hooks with x=1,c=2,ci=1,eta=.1,g=0: y=.9,ci_new=0,delta=-1. Repeat nonzero gradients [3,1]: y=.4,ci_new=2,delta=1. Independently record gradients and prove ci_new=their mean within atol=1e-12; do not compute expected values using strategy helpers. Baseline must fail the first case.

review.checks: Exact B git-object real zero-gradient SGD fails at y=1.1,ci~=1,delta~=0. Candidate real float64 SGD gives (.9,0,-1) and (.4,2,1) for gradients [0] and [3,1]; ci equals independently recorded mean gradients within 1e-12. V2 also matches.

contract.criteria: Load the real shipped TOML through Config; use the real optimizer factory and trainer with parameters.optimizer.lr overridden to .1 and .025, no trainer.lr or manually injected learning_rate. Verify correction and denominator, including a different LR next round and equal-rate reordered parameter groups. Missing optimizer, unequal group rates, nonfinite/zero rate and within-round scheduler changes give useful failures before the affected update, no control save/outbound success. Confirm captured executed LR is not replaced by a post-step hook's new LR.

review.checks: Inspected optimizer publication and actual public prehook capture at normal/tail steps. Executed shipped TOML Config+real optimizer-factory tests at .1/.025 and next-round .05; absent optimizer, unequal/reordered equal groups, zero/negative/NaN/Inf rates, and within-round change rejection. Post-step .025 cannot replace executed .1 correction or denominator. Failure clears outbound success and hooks.

contract.criteria: Use a model with a trainable parameter named theta, ordinary weight/bias, a frozen parameter, an optimizer-excluded parameter and floating/integer buffers. Verify theta is corrected, excluded/frozen values are unchanged by SCAFFOLD, and no buffer gets a parameter/control update. Known historical buffer extras are tolerated; missing/unknown/mismatched/nonfinite control values fail before parameter correction. Input control tensors remain unchanged.

review.checks: Reviewed validation/projection/clones by parameter name and optimizer object identity, no substring filters. Executed theta/weight/bias/missing-gradient unused parameter, frozen/excluded parameters, floating/integer buffers and reordered equal-rate groups. Missing/unknown/shape/nonfinite control failures precede correction; inbound tensors remain unchanged; excluded ci unchanged and delta zero.

Verify skipped-step flags suppress corrections. After a nonempty round, an empty/zero-update round retains ci and emits zero delta rather than stale data, with no divide-by-zero. contract.criteria: Load the shipped TOML and instantiate its actual example components with local synthetic quadratic data, real optimizer, processors and server aggregation. Retain raw config plus explicit test overrides: CPU, fixed seed, temporary paths, scalar float64 model and quadratic loss, plain SGD momentum=0, eta=.1,N=3,selected (1,2) then (1,3), actual sample counts (2,6,4), batch_size=6,epochs=2. Each client's samples repeat its own target, so one real minibatch per epoch gives K=2 for every client without falsifying sample counts. Match every local model/ci/delta and sample-weighted global model/population c to the retained rational oracle. Data gradients must come from real independent client training; do not fabricate payload deltas. Verify inactive ci unchanged and c=mean(all ci). Add equal-count case matching uniform paper aggregation. No dataset download or convergence benchmark required; an in-process real pipeline plus A06 spawn qualification suffices.

review.checks: Read the real committed TOML, recorded raw values and explicit synthetic CPU overrides. Actual sample counts 2/6/4, batch 6, two epochs, K=2, N=3, selected (1,2) then (1,3). Round 1 weighted x=1.19 vs uniform x=1, c=2/3; round 2 x=10209/10000,c=896/1125. Inactive ci retained and c equals mean all ci. Equal-count 2/2/2 two-round control reduces to uniform model reference.

contract.criteria: Use partial participation N>len(S), unequal sample counts and nonzero controls through actual weights_received/aggregation/weights_aggregated/customize_server_payload. Control update is sum(delta)/N, never sum(delta)/len(S) or sample weighting; next payload contains that c. Reject missing/malformed required deltas before committing either model/control state. Full model buffers remain under inherited aggregation behavior, without control keys/KeyError. A failed round leaves server state unchanged.
